text:
dmitri: Heads up — ran a quick correlation across the last 48h. Heatmap shows clusters by Xid code and tenant/model_family. Quick summary: Xid 13 spikes line up with long-context chat completions, Xid 79 correlates with embedding batch jobs on A10 pools (INT8 paths), and Xid 31 is concentrated on a few racks that have older firmware. Dropping the raw plots here and a prom query I used.

maya: can you paste the prom query and the heatmap link?

dmitri: sure — query I used (prom):
```
(sum by(node, xid_code) (increase(gpu_xid_total[2h])) / on(node) group_left() sum by(node) (increase(gpu_requests_total[2h]))) * 100
```
heatmap: https://stash.internal/infra/xid-heatmaps/1767201234.png

opsbot: ALERT: node a10-rack7-12 reported Xid=79 x6 in 15m (auto-ticket INC-8419 created) :warning:

ravi: For Xid=79 we've seen this pattern before — INT8 embedding kernels + long batch windows can trigger driver/kernel race on A10s. Can we test with FP16 embedder variant as a quick mitigation? :thinking_face:

claire: confirmed — I drained g10x-14 yesterday after 2x Xid=31 in 6h. Host logs had "GPU ECC error count increment" but no clear kernel OOPS. Suspect firmware/drv mismatch on those nodes. :white_check_mark:

jen: proposal: auto-drain policy = 3 occurrences of the same Xid code on one node within 30m triggers targeted drain + tenant-tagged alert. Also add routing fallback to a safer model variant while node is reprovisioning.

dmitri: +1. Also we should enrich telemetry: histogram of Xids by tenant and model_family. The heatmap shows tenant 'socialchat' accounting for ~40% of Xid=13 spikes (long-ish tail generations). If we can route them to a truncated-context variant or FP16 we might reduce error surface.

maya: If we route socialchat to FP16 for 24h, any reason it would break quality tests?

ravi: I'll run a 5% canary routing to FP16 for socialchat on us-west2 A10 pool and monitor Xid+latency. ETA ~30m. Will post results.

opsbot: DEPLOY: canary routing policy "xid79-fp16-canary" applied to prod in us-west2-a10 (5%) by ravi at 1767201520.

dmitri: Nice. Also, infra: schedule firmware rollout for racks {rack7, rack12, rack3} — Claire, can you open a vendor ticket and add the observed Xid histograms?

claire: opened INC-8427 with vendor, attached logs/heatmap and suggested firmware bump window Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC. Added host list and ECC counters.

jen: note on cost: routing customers to FP16 may slightly change token efficiency and perf. We should model billing delta vs retry savings tomorrow before wider rollout. :money_with_wings:

dmitri: agreed. closing loop: ravi will monitor canary for 24h; if Xid=79 rate drops >60% we scale FP16 canary and schedule larger mitigation. If not, we'll escalate to vendor and consider node replacement for the worst offenders. I'll compile a short triage doc after 24h.
